$Comment: A Hard weekly hunt for skeleton knights in any mix; Amount is the total across all of them. Targets lists the nine skeleton-knight roles (Skeleton_Knight, Skeleton_Burnt_Knight and Skeleton_Frost_Knight, each with its _Patrol and _Wander role), and MatchMode EXACT counts those ids alone, matched on the victim's role id without regard to case. That keeps out every other role with Knight in its id: Risen_Knight (the ally a Rekindle Embers spellbook raises), Shadow_Knight and the dev-only Test_Combat_Knight. To count another knight, add its role id to Targets. The step carries its own line (objective.text.bounty.skeleton_knights), since no single creature name covers all nine; change the targets and that key together. Keep this file name: saved progress is filed under the id, so a retarget rewords the quest.bounty_weekly_shadow_knight keys rather than renaming the file.
